passive.name: Promise
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by **16/19/22/25/28%**. While the wearer is in battle, for every **20%** CRIT DMG that exceeds **120%**, the DMG dealt by Follow-Up ATK increases by **12/14/16/18/20%**. This effect can stack up to **4** time(s). When the battle starts or after the wearer uses their Basic ATK, enables the DMG dealt by Ultimate or Follow-Up ATK to ignore **20/24/28/32/36%** of the target's DEF, lasting for **2** turn(s).

passive.name: Meteor Swarm
passive.text: For every enemy on the field, increases the wearer's ATK by **9/10.5/12/13.5/15%**, up to 5 stacks. When an enemy is inflicted with Weakness Break, the DMG dealt by the wearer increases by **30/35/40/45/50%** for 1 turn.

passive.name: Each Now Has a Role to Play
passive.text: Increases the wearer's ATK by **16/20/24/28/32%**. When the wearer defeats an enemy, the wearer's CRIT DMG increases by **24/30/36/42/48%** for **3** turn(s).

passive.name: Boundless Thought
passive.text: Increases the wearer's ATK by **8/9/10/11/12%**. After using an attack, for each enemy target hit, additionally increases ATK by **4/5/6/7/8%**. This effect can stack up to 5 times and last until the next attack. If there are **3** or more enemy targets hit, this unit's SPD increases by **8/10/12/14/16%**, lasting for **1** turn(s).

passive.name: Long Night
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by **36/42/48/54/60%**. Increases DMG dealt by the wearer's Skill and Ultimate by **18/21/24/27/30%**. After the wearer uses Skill or Ultimate, gains "Somnus Corpus." Upon triggering a Follow-Up ATK, consumes "Somnus Corpus," and increases DMG dealt by Follow-Up ATK by **48/56/64/72/80%**.

passive.name: A Storm Is Coming
passive.text: After entering battle, increases the wearer's DMG based on their Max Energy. Each point of Energy increases DMG by **0.2/0.25/0.3/0.35/0.4%**. A max of **160** Energy will be taken into account for this.

passive.name: Get Ready
passive.text: Increases the wearer's DMG by **12/15/18/21/24%**. For every enemy defeated by the wearer, the wearer's ATK increases by **4/5/6/7/8%**, stacking up to **3** time(s).

substatLine: SPD (breakpoint) > CRIT Rate = CRIT DMG > ATK%
tracePriority: Bide Time (A4) > Winning Hand (A6) > Tile Battle (A2)

entries.name: Flower Pick
entries.text: Tosses 1 jade tile from the suit with the fewest tiles in hand to deal Quantum DMG equal to **100%** of Qingque's ATK to one designated enemy.

entries.name: Cherry on Top!
entries.text:
Deals Quantum DMG equal to **240%** of Qingque's ATK to one designated enemy, and deals Quantum DMG equal to **100%** of Qingque's ATK to enemies adjacent to it.
"Cherry on Top!" cannot recover Skill Points.

entries.name: A Scoop of Moon
entries.text: Immediately draws **2** jade tile(s) and increases DMG by **28%** until the end of the current turn. This effect can stack up to **4** time(s). The turn will not end after this Skill is used.

entries.name: A Quartet? Woo-hoo!
entries.text: Deals Quantum DMG equal to **200%** of Qingque's ATK to all enemies, and obtains 4 jade tiles of the same suit.

entries.name: Celestial Jade
entries.text:
When an ally's turn starts, Qingque randomly draws 1 tile from 3 different suits and can hold up to 4 tiles at one time.
If Qingque starts her turn with 4 tiles of the same suit, she consumes all tiles to enter the "Hidden Hand" state.
While in this state, Qingque cannot use her Skill again. At the same time, Qingque's ATK increases by **72%**, and her Basic ATK "Flower Pick" is enhanced, becoming "Cherry on Top!" The "Hidden Hand" state ends after using "Cherry on Top!".

entries.name: Game Solitaire
entries.text: After using Technique, Qingque draws **2** jade tile(s) when the battle starts.

entries.name: Tile Battle
entries.text: Restores 1 Skill Point when using the Skill. This effect can only be triggered 1 time per battle.

entries.name: Bide Time
entries.text: Using the Skill increases DMG Boost effect of attacks by an extra **10%**.

entries.name: Winning Hand
entries.text: Qingque's SPD increases by **10%** for 1 turn after using the Enhanced Basic ATK.

entries.name: Sleep on the Tiles
entries.text: Every time Draw Tile is triggered, Qingque immediately regenerates 1 Energy.

entries.name: Read Between the Tiles
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Right on the Tiles
entries.text:
After using Skill, there is a 24% fixed chance to gain "Self-Sufficer," lasting until the end of the current turn.
While "Self-Sufficer" is active, using Basic ATK or Enhanced Basic ATK immediately launches 1 Follow-Up ATK on the same target, dealing Quantum DMG equal to 100% of Basic ATK DMG or Enhanced Basic ATK DMG.

entries.name: Gambit for the Tiles
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Prevail Beyond the Tiles
entries.text: Recovers 1 Skill Point after using Enhanced Basic ATK.
